mathematical_meanings: Left image: O names the center of the circle (the interior dot in the circle with an inscribed quadrilateral). Right image: O names the origin of the coordinate axes (the label where the x and h axes meet).
Rationales: On the left, O names the center of the circle (the interior dot in the circle with an inscribed quadrilateral). On the right, O names the origin of the coordinate axes (the label where the x and h axes meet).
